name: Found at Sea
source:
You awaken in an unfamiliar place. A stranger greets you, but despite the polite smile on his face, something about the situation unnerves you.

[From [url=https://avistella.itch.io/found-at-sea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个陌生的地方醒来。一个陌生人向你打招呼，尽管他脸上挂着礼貌的微笑，但这种情况却让你感到不安。

[来自[url=https://avistella.itch.io/found-at-sea]Itch.io[/url]]
